title: Battle of Fort Coimbra
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Fort Coimbra", at revision 1370440871, opens: "The Battle of Fort Coimbra was the opening move of the Paraguayan War's Mato Grosso campaign. It was made of five infantry battalions and two dismounted cavalry regiments, totalling 3,200 men, with 12 rifled guns, a French-equipped rocket battery and the support of 11 warships, all under Colonel Vicente Barrios's command." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5778798, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1864 battle of the Paraguayan War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
